> @copilot 仔细检查所有相关代码评估是否已经完成了任务中的所有要求

Re-audited the full codebase against all 6 requirements in the issue. Found and fixed 2 remaining `{_id}` URL templates in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` (commit `03a58c1`).

**Final audit results:**

| Pattern | Status | Details |
|---------|--------|---------|
| `modified_at` / `modified_by` | ✅ Clean | Zero remaining in code/docs |
| `space_id` | ✅ Clean | Zero remaining in code/docs |
| Standalone `_id` in protocol code | ✅ Clean | All 40 files fixed across objectql, core, spec, runtime, rest, client, studio, examples, docs, prompts |
| `_id` in storage layer (NoSQL/Mingo) | ✅ Intentionally preserved | MongoDB `$group._id`, `$lookup.foreignField`, shardKey, projection — per issue guidance |
| `_id` as TS unused param (`_id: string`) | ✅ Correct | Standard TypeScript convention for unused parameters |
| `_id` in doc comments ("MUST NOT return `_id`") | ✅ Correct | Documenting the convention itself |

All 6625 spec tests + 85 runtime + 40 rest + 134 objectql tests pass. Pre-existing failures in `plugin.integration.test.ts` (7) and `memory-driver.test.ts` (1) are unrelated to these changes.
